clips.title: The story
paras: Kebok in Booty Bay needs materials to meet export demands for tiger fangs destined for the South Seas. Because hunting genuine jungle predators proves too costly, he has devised an undetectable forging process using tusks harvested from the Skullsplitter trolls.

Supplying tiger fangs to distant island buyers across the South Seas has grown too expensive and difficult through ordinary hunting. Rather than abandon the trade, Kebok devised an undetectable forging method that turns mundane horn-like objects into convincing replicas. The closest physical match for these fangs comes directly from the jaws of the local Skullsplitter trolls, leading Kebok to hire adventurers willing to strip eighteen tusks from the jungle tribe to fill his upcoming export shipment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's expensive and hard to kill enough tigers to support the export of tiger fangs to the islands in the South Seas. Luckily, we've developed a technique that allows us to take mundane horn-like objects and turn them into undetectable forgeries.
The closest match we've found, amazingly, are the tusks of the Skullsplitter trolls.
Hey, before you say anything, what the buyer doesn't know doesn't hurt them, am I right? Bring me a large number of them so we can get to work on the monthly shipment!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Tough buggers, aren't they? Well, have you had any luck? Sorry to seem impatient, but this has been a huge thorn in my side! Well?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, good work, good work! Ugh, though you could have done a better job cleaning off the-- Well, no matter, no matter! My thanks to you, friend, our operation will no doubt see increased output and productivity thanks to your help! Good good, now, onto other matters...
